data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-l-l', meaning 'to flow'. Jleelaht refers to a gentle flow of water, which can symbolize the smoothness and tranquility of life. The name Jleelaht carries the meaning “Gentle flow of water” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jleelaht usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flow of water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
